question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_best AS (
    SELECT ra.year, r.constructor_id, MAX(r.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, r.constructor_id
),
team_best AS (
    SELECT ra.year, cr.constructor_id, MAX(cr.points) as best_team_points
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN races ra ON cr.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, cr.constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.constructor_id, d.best_driver_points, t.best_team_points,
           d.best_driver_points + t.best_team_points as combined_points
    FROM driver_best d
    JOIN team_best t ON d.year = t.year AND d.constructor_id = t.constructor_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY combined_points DESC) as dr
    FROM combined
)
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, r.year, r.combined_points
FROM ranked r
JOIN constructors_ext c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE r.dr <= 3
ORDER BY r.combined_points DESC, r.year ASC
